value.rationale: The physical meeting/reaction problem for two independent walkers is natural, and the sharp all-dimension rank stratification reveals a previously unquantified hierarchy of unequal rational hopping resonances. The earliest resonance dimension p+q and exact binomial onset separate arithmetic commensurability from the familiar equal-speed symmetry phenomenon; this is a structural result for an infinite family, not an arbitrary finite enumeration.
